nom: Lancôme Clarifique Pro-Solution Brightening & Dark Spot Reducing Serum

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report the serum leaves no oily residue and improves bumpy, dull texture without causing breakouts.
segments.dry: A reviewer with very dry skin and rosacea says it made skin feel soft and hydrated with smoother makeup application.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers most often report no irritation, no redness and calming effects, though a minority describe redness, breakouts or recurring fever blisters.
segments.mature: Mature-skin reviewers describe it as recommended for their age group, citing improved elastin support, reduced fine lines and a lifting, firming feel.
segments.combination: One reviewer with sensitive, acne-prone (combination-leaning) skin found it non-irritating but saw no noticeable brightening results.

concerns.aging: Reviewers mention reduced fine lines, elastin support and a lifted, firmer feel; only a couple of comments address aging specifically.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers describe increased softness, hydration and glow, including one with very dry skin and rosacea reporting smoother, hydrated skin.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers who mention redness report calming and no reaction, but one reviewer had redness after the first use and another repeatedly triggered fever-blister breakouts.
concerns.barrier: A few reviewers note the serum is gentle and works well layered under moisturizer and sunscreen without disrupting skin comfort.
concerns.spots: Many reviewers report visible fading of dark spots, sun spots, age spots and melasma within weeks; several others saw no change at all even after finishing a full bottle.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers with acne-prone skin report fading of acne scars, marks and texture and calming of active breakouts, but one sensitive-acne-prone reviewer saw no improvement and another developed new breakouts.
concerns.oiliness: A small number of reviewers note the serum leaves skin feeling clean and non-oily rather than addressing oil production directly.

aspects.libelle: Dropper dispenses too much or erratically
Strong jalapeño-like smell bothers some users

extraits.texte: I tried this product out multiple times and just thought it was okay, but it didn't "wow" me. I know brightening products typically require extended use to see results but even after multiple uses I didn't have any, even minor, noticeable differences. I like the packaging, specific the pump design, and the texture/feel of the product. You do also get a good amount of product in the bottle too. I have sensitive acne prone skin and it didn't irritate me or cause breakouts but it also didn't do much else on the positive side either. I've tried many products and treatments for hyperpigmentation (at a variety of price points) that I started seeing noticeable results after a few uses so the lack of with this one is a miss for me. Especially at a premium price point. Overall I wouldn't re purchase or recommend, I think there's better options out there that offer the same solutions.

I am about one-fourth through the bottle, and the difference is not very evident yet in terms of lightening brown spots and refining pores. Understanding these things normally take time to correct, I will finish the whole bottle before making a final judgment on its effectiveness. The good thing is this serum does not irritate my sensitive skin. The texture is a bit watery, and the solution squirts out a little out of control.
